snippet.title: Rec Room is now on Nintendo Switch™! | OFFICIAL LAUNCH TRAILER
snippet.description:
Rec Room is now officially available on  Nintendo Switch™! Get ready to explore, create, and play countless games and experiences with ALL your friends. Whether you’re into epic adventures, creative building, or just hanging out in a virtual space, Rec Room has something for everyone.

Download Rec Room from the @NintendoAmerica eShop and join the fun on your #NintendoSwitch!
👉 Key Features:
Cross-platform play with friends across console, PC, VR, and mobile
A massive library of player-created games and worlds
Easy-to-use tools to create your own games and experiences
🔗 Download Now: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/rec-room-switch/


Check out our other social media channels:
• TikTok - https://www.tiktok.com/@recroom?lang=en
• Instagram - https://www.instagram.com/recroom/​
• Threads - https://www.threads.net/@recroom
• Twitter - https://twitter.com/recroom
• Reddit - https://www.reddit.com/r/RecRoom/
• Discord - https://discord.gg/recroom

Visit our other websites:
• https://rec.net - for all your Rec Room social media needs
• https://recroom.com - event news, dev blogs, updates and more
• https://recroom.com/howtocreate - Learn how to build rooms
• https://recroom.com/creative - Sign up for creative classes
